name: VPN & Encrypted Tunnel Pivoting
description: Ability to create VPN and encrypted tunnels through compromised hosts for full network-layer pivoting. Covers deployment of VPN servers on pivot hosts, use of tools like Ligolo-ng, WireGuard, and OpenVPN for layer-3 tunneling, and routing configuration for transparent network access to segmented environments.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to VPN-based pivoting techniques

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands the difference between port-level and network-level tunneling and when VPN pivoting is advantageous
evidence: Can explain the advantages of layer-3 tunneling over port forwarding
Understands basic VPN concepts (tun/tap interfaces, routing)
Knows tools like Ligolo-ng, WireGuard, and their role in pivoting

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Deploys basic VPN tunnels through pivot hosts under supervision
evidence: Sets up Ligolo-ng or similar tools to create a tunnel through a pivot host
Configures local routing to direct traffic through the VPN tunnel
Accesses services on the remote network through the established tunnel
Documents VPN tunnel configurations and routing under review

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently deploys and manages VPN tunnels for full network access during engagements
evidence: Deploys VPN tunnels appropriate to the target environment and detection risk
Configures routing for multiple subnets through VPN pivot points
Maintains stable VPN tunnels with recovery procedures for engagement continuity
Runs any tool natively over the VPN tunnel without compatibility issues

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Manages complex VPN architectures across multiple segments; mentors others
evidence: Deploys multi-hop VPN chains for deep network penetration
Configures encrypted tunnels through restrictive egress filtering
Manages VPN infrastructure for team-wide access on large engagements
Mentors junior staff on VPN pivoting techniques and troubleshooting

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines VPN pivoting methodology; develops custom tunnel solutions; trains teams
evidence: Authored the lab's VPN pivoting and tunnel management methodology
Develops custom tunneling solutions for specialized or constrained environments
Published research on network-layer pivoting techniques
Trains teams on VPN pivoting strategy and infrastructure management

assessment_methods.description: Deploy a VPN tunnel through a pivot host and demonstrate full network access to a segmented lab environment, running multiple tools transparently
Given a pivot host with limited outbound access, establish a VPN tunnel to provide team-wide access to the internal network
